name: Residence Permit -- Dependent Category

qualifying_event.description: A non-citizen dependent of a Botswana resident or citizen (a 'supporter') applies for a Residence Permit under the dependent category.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Supporter's particulars (ID or permit), proof of the supporter's work authorization, and a support letter.

requirements.blocker_text: A supporter in Botswana (a resident or citizen) provides particulars (ID/permit), proof of work authorization, and a support letter.
Dependents over 18 must apply individually rather than as part of another family member's application.

evidence_required.document: Marriage or birth certificate proving the family tie

outcome.duration_length: not specified; up to 2 years noted for visiting dependents under the visitor-visa category; residence permit processed within 30 working days

sources.title: gov.bw (Botswana government portal), Department of Immigration and Citizenship -- Residence Permit Application: dependent category requires a supporter's particulars, work-authorization proof, and support letter; applicants over 18 apply individually

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Botswana). STATUS: DRAFT -- thin, tier-1 sourced. This models the general dependent-of-resident category rather than the specific spouse-of-citizen marriage route, which is treated separately as it leads toward bw_citizenship_by_marriage.json. work_rights is set 'none' as the conservative default since the source does not state a dependent-permit holder may work -- distinct from bw_citizenship_by_marriage.json's spouse route, which has its own separate residence basis under the naturalisation requirement (5 years' residence while married).
